main_text.l: Mararetta Mavaos, unica Pottii Heredi, Dux Brabantiæ &c. Comes Flandriæ, Superioris Burgundiæ, &c.
Ioannes Cognomento Intrepidus.
Philippus Bonus.
Carolus Temerarius.
Maria, nupta Maximiliano Austr.
Philippus Austriacus.
Carolus V. Imperator &c.
Philippus Hispaniarum Rex
Philippus Hispaniarum Monarcha.
Quod ad Statum huius Liberi Comitatus Politicum, quoties Comitia Provincia-
lia sunt agenda, tres Status conveniunt, convocante eos nomine Comitis Principe
Arausiorum, Nozereti & Arlæi Lynasta. Sunt autem Nobiles, Ecclesiastici, Ur-
bes. Eorum hunc syllabum debemus Gilberto Nozereno: Superioris Diœcesis Comites: Montbeliart, Roche, & Varax, Montrimel,
Thoiamcy & Vaulgrenans, Vergey, Rey, Lisllenoss; Abbates: Croissant, Charité, Bizaine, Corneul, Tulley, Clafont, Luxeul,
Belleranlx, Grace-Dieu, Charleu, Trium Regum: Priores: Vauciuse, Lantenans, Cusance, Mar-
teret, Iussey, Port sus Saosne, Montreul ad Sgonam, S. Marcelli: Canonici: Calemostier, &
alij alijs locis: Urbes: Gray, Vesoul, Montboisson, Iussey, Palma, Port sus Saone, Cromary, Mont-Iustin, Faulcogney:
Domini: Aumont & S. Loup, S. Martii, Taulens Villeneufve, Rupt, Montgevelle, Chastillon &
Relvye, Conflandey, Mentaillon, Vellefon, Dicey, Igny & Chemylly, d'Oiselet, Cicon, Trafves, Raincounieres, Cosebrune, Sombernom, Valle-faulx,
Bermont, D'Avilley, Mugnay Vereur, Touraize, Citey, Provanchieres, Grand-mont, Velle
Cheurelous, Voysey, Dampierre, Freteij, Benlta, Matay, Notrende, Tromarcy, Millesey,
Maillerconcurt, Myon, Bennenge, Villeroi le Loz, Cierlé, Betoucourt, Mointaillotte, D'Amon-
dans, & de Fraisne, Chavirey, Mortot, Mons S. Legier, Cuvry, Montereul, Sorans, &
Lambry: & alij permulti. Inferioris Comites sunt Ruffey & S. Aubin: Baro, Chevreaulx:
Abbatis: S. Fugendi, Beaume, Baierne, Mont S. Marie, Mont-Benoist, Beylen, Raufieres; Priores: Mainnaul, Vauclufe, Bonlieu, Mente,
Lonfle Saulnier, Arbois, Mote, Syrodi, Vallis supra Polichnium, Mortau: Canonici S. Mauritij, S. Anatoly, S. Michaelis, Salinisom-
nes; Arbosiensis, Polichnienses, Nozeretenses, & aliarum Urbium Locorumque
alij: Urbes; Salma, Aalois, Poligny, Pontarlien, Nozeret, Castrum Karoli, Monmorets, Orgelot.
Domini: Coniogna & Andelet, Courtiau & le Pin, S. Amour, Argento, Laubespin,
Pompet, S. Sorlin, Dannam, & Tramecay, Bofia, Cresta, Fitigny, Chamberia Montena, Vecles,
Rosait, Narigna, Beau-fort, Nascy, L'Auge, Courtoion, Vertamboz, Largilla, Moiron,
L'Esloille, Chasnee, Arefibe, Coges, Bar, & Iousseaul, D'Augea Muyre, Charrin, Charlin, Chau-
mes, Breterreres, Fontenay, Cognya, Chaux, Mentuet, Vadsus, Villette, Les Arbois,
Aiglepierre, Chasteleuvillain, S. Iulian. Deserines, Verges, Chay, Champaigne, Bea-
nichemin, Villeneufuelez, Orgelet, Chastes. Præfectus Arcis de Ioulx, sive Iura Montis, Vincelle,
Visneaulx, & alij multi. Dolanæ Diœcesis: Dominus de Givrey: Longepierre, &
Rahon, Clervaux: Abbates: Billon, S. Vincentij, S. Pauli Bisantij, D'Acey: Priores: Loye,
Lanval, Damparis, Iouhe, Monterot, Mote supra Altam Petram, Faye, Moster in Secusia:
Canonici, Dolani, Bisuntinenses, & alij alijs locis: Urbes; Dola, Quingenum, Ornans,
Loya, Rochefort, Vercel: Domini; Vauidrey, Rainnes, Rye, Monfort, Mont-
Richard, Fertans, Maillot, Bermont, Cleron, Verchamps, Doffans, Port, Chasteau Rottlant,
D'Abbans & Marchault, Reculet, Chantrans, Mont-Grosfain, Mutigny, Chassey, Pareissey, Choisey, S. Ligé.
Faye, Parrel, Chemin, Rabus, Champ-divers, & Rasionieres, Raincheconrt, Vaisitre, Montrambart,
Salins, Goussans, Chaverey, Ancer, & alij. Nobilitas huius Comitatus, ut hinc
videmus, valde est frequens. Quatuor autem sunt Familiæ, quæ à Burgundiæ Regibus &
Principibus originem trahere, vel cum ijs ad nitatem contraxisse commemora-
ntur: De Vienne, cui Nobilitatis Epitheton tribuitur; De Vergy, cui Strenuæ Titulus tribuitur; De
Chalon, quæ Opulenta Dominus nomen obtinet: Arausiorumque Principatus
Titulum; De Neuf Chastel, quæ Feudis est Insignis.
Quum autem Comitatus in tres, ut iam vidimus, Diœceses & Præfecturas, quæ
Baillivatus vulgo, iuri facilius dicundo, divisa sit; Dolanam, Superiorem, Inferiorem: Primæ

page.notes: The genealogical diagram at top right is set in small italic type; its label "De his alibi satis" is at the brace. The marginal notes on the left read "Status Politicus.", "Familiæ Nobiles" and "Comitatus Divisio." Several place names in the dense list are doubtful, notably Calemostier, Salma, Vertamboz, Ornans, Cognya and Bisuntinenses, and are transcribed as best read. The final line ends "Primæ", continuing on the next page.
